name: fishtape-mobile
description: Fishtape iOS app: Capacitor wrapper around ../electrical-app plus the native ARKit measuring plugin.

scripts.build:sim: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath "${DERIVED_DATA_PATH:-.derived}" build
scripts.build:device: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath "${DERIVED_DATA_PATH:-.derived}" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
